sections.title: ADR: package boundaries and Action mapping
sections.text: Accepted boundaries D1–D4: retain agentools/sdk, AgenTools\, PHP >=8.3, Dart core and MCP; preserve dated 2026-09 ActionStatus and frozen 2026-08 inputs. Planned pure core holds ports/value objects; PostgreSQL, Laravel AI, Laravel, testing, Chatom, Loqum, Filament and scheduler are adapters or extensions. Actions do not import Assistant Runtime. Only one loop executes a turn; provider returns proposals; existing ConfirmationService, EventStore, fencing and Action journal remain the boundary. EffectCommitter in-memory append is not proof of durable commit before IO. Private package naming and graph confirmation belong to P1.4; no rename, public release or license mutation is authorized. MIT donor attribution/license must be documented without changing recipient license.

sections.title: Compatibility, consumers, migration and unknowns
sections.text: Preserve PHP and Dart SDK, spec, fixtures and conformance, independent headless Actions and offline-first Dart. Compatibility facades are planned per row; no facade is claimed implemented. Draft/publish configuration and old/new single-writer cutover require consumer-specific mapping, snapshot/backfill checks and rollback without two effect-capable loops. P13 owns cutover and regression; P1.3 owns independent consumer verification. Chatom owns history, host owns authorization/consent/facts, ControLLM owns metering, Tariffler owns admission, money owner owns ledger. Provider docs, model support/prices, AiResto/ERP bindings, voice entrypoints, test execution, exhaustive caller closure and exact per-row migration mapping are pending, not zero or unsupported.

sections.title: Voice and independent consumer search boundary
sections.text: A case-insensitive search for voice/audio/Loqum/STT/TTS in the eight Botkit package src directories and assistant routes produced no matches. This is a bounded source observation, not proof that external voice entrypoints or integrations do not exist. P11.3/knowledge/eco.voice#voice owns proposed host contract; ECO-VOICE-001..008 are planned host-harness cases, not live evidence. A scoped search for AgenTools/Botkit PHP imports and Composer requirements in Edufy, ERP SDK and Chatom excluding vendor/tests yielded no matches; repository availability or independent consumers outside those patterns are not disproven. AiResto remains unavailable. PHP production and Dart core smoke consumers are present and referenced by source paths. P1.3 owns actual independent consumer compatibility closure.

sections.title: Compatibility and migration obligations by existing owner
sections.text: P6.1 / knowledge/root.botkit-migration#botkit-migration owns managed/raw/build/stream/background/voice shared guard composition and tenant reset, CM-041/042. P6.5 owns scheduler occurrence identity, CM-045..048. P13.1 owns capability-by-capability shadow read-only comparisons, resumable dry-run/count/hash/checkpoint backfill, select one writer and rollback (CUT-001); it does not authorize donor edits. P13.2 preserves existing PHP/Dart scenario identities (REG-001). P1.3 owns dated wire and independent consumers (ACT-006). These are recorded target obligations and ownership, not an executed facade or verified migration; exact data mapping and host-specific authorization are pending.

claims.statement: run executes authorization, message security and before plugins, then prompt, after plugins and completion event.
stream shares preflight but returns stream response without after-run plugins or BotRunCompleted.
agent and agentByType build through authorization hooks; managed message security and run plugins are not invoked.
Options are mutable; definition key and scope columns identify the row, with a global row when scope is absent.
Definitions, plugins and class-map tools have runtime registration entrypoints.
Fake supplies assertions for recorded runs, hooks and security events.
Scheduler exists; tenant isolation and replay properties require further investigation.
Existing journal and reducer implement dated Actions; preserve wire status.
Trusted-port confirmation service exists; runtime test results not inferred.
Journal append is in-memory; durable persistence before external IO is not established by this class.
PostgreSQL event store and idempotency coordinator exist; recovery behavior requires actual suite evidence.
ScenarioRunner and LlmPort::respond(array):array are existing integration points.
CLI resolves agent or subAgent then calls prompt directly; managed pipeline is not entered by this command.
Creates research log, calls SDK agent prompt directly and dispatches handlers; managed pipeline equivalence is not proven.
Directly constructs structured SDK agent and prompts it; writes analysis logs and reports.
Uses Laravel AI ConversationStore for conversation history and local metadata; send and stream delegate to managed Botkit calls.
Config-gated conversation and stream routes use controller and configured middleware.
CurrentBotRun singleton is flushed before queue jobs and, when octane.listeners is enabled, on OperationTerminated.
Configured stages process SecurityContext through Laravel pipeline; target mandatory guards must not be optional plugins.
Plugins are activated from per-bot options and expose lifecycle hooks; mandatory security cannot depend on an optional plugin.
Permission check allows empty configured permission; authorization is plugin-dependent.
Job class comes from botkit.jobs.run_agent config; missing class raises an error.
Queue job invokes research orchestrator.
Configurable retries/backoff; emits proposed comment and updates scheduled slot status.
Queue job invokes publish pipeline action; other article and manual jobs remain distinct paths.
Admin CRUD reads registered definitions, tools, middleware and option schemas against bot_agents.
AgentPrompted usage, when present, is forwarded to metrics with current-run context or agent class fallback. Coverage of all provider paths is unproven.
Delegates Gemini cache lifecycle to configured port; exact provider capabilities remain unverified.
ScheduleTriggered key botkit.agent.{id} resolves a BotAgent and dispatches a job; exactly-once occurrence not established.
Existing long-operation coordination is part of SDK; claims require its tests, not source presence.
Existing PostgreSQL idempotency store supplies fenced identity boundary; isolated database tests remain pending.
Existing durable journal facade; durable intent before external IO must be separately demonstrated.
Dart core public library and direct offline Actions are compatibility obligations.
One AgenTools platform with Assistant Runtime and Actions; separate Botkit and EvalKit are not created.
Private additive core and adapters with a single execution writer, retaining dated Actions and SDKs.
Independent AiResto/ERP consumer paths and provider capabilities, exact pricing and live readiness remain unverified.
Token consume uses tenant_id and token_id conflict key; differing digest produces collision and repeated equal token is spent.
The dated PHP action status enum is an existing public wire boundary.
Scenario semantic retry invokes ToolPort with the same derived key under bounded attempts; handleFailure comments describe future journal-aware invocation retry.
Admin approve/reject directly updates research proposal status; approved article action conditionally dispatches publish job.
Job carries proposalId/trigger, configures queue with three retries and delegates to article action.
Job fetches publisher by ID, checks its type, locks agent and delegates to RunContentPublishLlmAction with manual context text.
Command queries every agent with non-null cadence and dispatches a job; no due-time comparison is visible in handle, and it returns success after reported individual failures.
Command calls BotAgentCadenceScheduler::registerAll and reports schedules synced; register method inspected separately contains no executable registration.

Additive platform; preserve SDK, wire, external ownership and private migration.

Per-row concrete facade, acceptance and migration/backfill/rollback details remain owned by later implementation phases; tests listed are identified or pending.
All statuses reflect observation at checkout time, not a freeze of later worktrees.
